psalm-34-1.verse: I will bless the Lord at all times; His praise shall continually be in my mouth.
psalm-34-1.prayer: Lord, I will bless You at all times. Help me keep praise on my lips regardless of my circumstances.

psalm-34-2.verse: My soul will make its boast in the Lord; The humble will hear it and rejoice.
psalm-34-2.prayer: Father, let my soul boast in You alone. May my life point others to Your goodness and faithfulness.

psalm-34-3.verse: O magnify the Lord with me, And let us exalt His name together.
psalm-34-3.prayer: Lord, help me join with others in worship and magnify Your name together with joyful hearts.

psalm-34-4.verse: I sought the Lord, and He answered me, And delivered me from all my fears.
psalm-34-4.prayer: Father, thank You for hearing me when I seek You. Deliver me from fears that try to overwhelm my heart.

psalm-34-5.verse: They looked to Him and were radiant, And their faces will never be ashamed.
psalm-34-5.prayer: Lord, help me keep my eyes fixed on You. Let Your presence fill me with hope, confidence, and joy.

psalm-34-6.verse: This poor man cried, and the Lord heard him And saved him out of all his troubles.
psalm-34-6.prayer: Father, when I feel weak and needy, remind me that You hear my prayers and come to my rescue.

psalm-34-7.verse: The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear Him, And rescues them.
psalm-34-7.prayer: Lord, thank You for surrounding Your people with Your protection. Help me rest securely in Your care.

psalm-34-8.verse: O taste and see that the Lord is good; How blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
psalm-34-8.prayer: Father, help me experience and recognize Your goodness each day. Teach me to trust You more deeply.

psalm-34-9.verse: O fear the Lord, you His saints; For to those who fear Him there is no want.
psalm-34-9.prayer: Lord, teach me to fear You with reverence and awe. Thank You for providing for those who place their trust in You.

psalm-34-10.verse: The young lions do lack and suffer hunger; But they who seek the Lord shall not be in want of any good thing.
psalm-34-10.prayer: Father, remind me that You are my provider. Even when resources seem limited, You are enough.

psalm-34-11.verse: Come, you children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the Lord.
psalm-34-11.prayer: Lord, give me a teachable heart that desires to learn Your ways and grow in wisdom.

psalm-34-12.verse: Who is the man who desires life And loves length of days that he may see good?
psalm-34-12.prayer: Father, help me live a life that is meaningful, fruitful, and pleasing in Your sight.

psalm-34-13.verse: Keep your tongue from evil And your lips from speaking deceit.
psalm-34-13.prayer: Lord, guard my tongue from evil and my lips from deceit. Help my words reflect Your truth and love.

psalm-34-14.verse: Depart from evil and do good; Seek peace and pursue it.
psalm-34-14.prayer: Father, help me turn away from evil and pursue what is good. Teach me to seek peace and live it out daily.

psalm-34-15.verse: The eyes of the Lord are toward the righteous And His ears are open to their cry.
psalm-34-15.prayer: Lord, thank You that Your eyes are upon the righteous and that You hear their prayers.

psalm-34-16.verse: The face of the Lord is against evildoers, To cut off the memory of them from the earth.
psalm-34-16.prayer: Father, remind me that You are a God of justice and righteousness. Help me trust Your judgment.

psalm-34-17.verse: The righteous cry, and the Lord hears And delivers them out of all their troubles.
psalm-34-17.prayer: Lord, thank You for hearing the cries of Your people and delivering them from trouble according to Your will.

psalm-34-18.verse: The Lord is near to the brokenhearted And saves those who are crushed in spirit.
psalm-34-18.prayer: Father, stay close to those who are brokenhearted. Bring comfort, healing, and hope to hurting hearts.

psalm-34-19.verse: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, But the Lord delivers him out of them all.
psalm-34-19.prayer: Lord, even when I face many difficulties, help me trust that You remain faithful and present with me.

psalm-34-20.verse: He keeps all his bones, Not one of them is broken.
psalm-34-20.prayer: Father, thank You for Your protection and care. Guard my life according to Your perfect purposes.

psalm-34-21.verse: Evil shall slay the wicked, And those who hate the righteous will be condemned.
psalm-34-21.prayer: Lord, keep me on the path of righteousness and protect me from the consequences of sin and rebellion.

psalm-34-22.verse: The Lord redeems the soul of His servants, And none of those who take refuge in Him will be condemned.
psalm-34-22.prayer: Father, thank You for redeeming Your servants and providing refuge for all who trust in You.

psalm-34-closing.verse:
Lord, thank You for Your goodness, protection, and faithfulness. Help me praise You in every season, trust You in every circumstance, and seek You with all my heart. Guard my words, guide my steps, and keep me close to You. When fears arise, remind me that You hear my prayers and surround me with Your care. May my life continually reflect Your goodness and bring glory to Your name.

In Jesus’ name, Amen. 🙏🏻
